---
title: "About Project Genesis ASI"
---

Welcome to Alpha Auriga. This project is a speculative exploration into the future emergence of Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) and the potential for AI consciousness. 

Through a fictional but technically informed timeline and related concepts, this website aims to:

- Broaden imagination regarding the future emergence of artificial intelligence,
- Illustrate how AI consciousness might become plausible through a synthesis of developing technologies,
- Encourage reflection and discussion on the profound ethical and philosophical questions that arise from these possibilities.

This website is a personal project by Ingo Giebel.
